summary: Fixed race condition in next_id() by adding file-based locking using fcntl to protect the load-compute-save operation atomically.
risks: fcntl is Unix-only; will not work on Windows (would need msvcrt.locking or portalocker)
Lock file persists after operations (by design for multi-process coordination)
limitations: Only add() operation is protected; other operations (mark_done, remove) could still have race conditions but are less critical
